answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 152231 Country: Pakistan Title: Is the name Shoaibur Rahman permissible? Question: Is the name Shoaibur Rahman permissible? Answer ID: 152231 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 920/747/D=9/1438) It is lawful to name Shoaibur Rahman, rather it is preferable as Shuaib was the name of one prophet and Rahman is one of the attributive names of Allah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
